answer.explanation: From 17:50:45 to 17:54:23 the Thumbnailer logged repeated AccessDenied errors on every s3:PutObject to lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi/thumbnailer/. The error says no identity-based policy allows s3:PutObject for assumed role lambda-rca-bench-ThumbnailerRole-uSLz6w9BZbU1. The invocations themselves are otherwise healthy (REPORT lines show about 116 MB used of 1024 MB and normal durations), so the denial is an IAM permission gap, not a code or config fault. The CrudApi, Uploader and Compression functions logged no error-pattern matches in the window, and no alarms were active. I could not inspect the role policy or IaC template with the tools available, so the candidate artifacts are inferred from the error text.
